fields.totalCount: Returned center count in Service Application. Service Application uses To Do; Profile Verification is its returned pending profile population. Do not assume these are the same entity or status scope.
fields.totalTasks: Returned Total Tasks in Service Application. Service Application combines selected-period todo and completed tasks. Profile Verification follows its own profile query; the label alone does not prove all historical profiles.
fields.doneToday: Returned Done Today in Service Application. Service Application computes this independently of the selected date range. Profile Verification counts today-updated records within the returned pending-profile set; do not relabel this as all approved/rejected profiles.
fields.overdueTasks: Returned Overdue Tasks for Service Application, a count separate from SLA percentage. Preserve a returned zero as the panel value; it does not certify another queue has no overdue records.

This endpoint has no scope query parameter. Its inspected implementation uses the department-wide license view and checks the current native identity. Do not inherit personal scope from another endpoint or treat this definition as a grant of access.

Active, Expired, ExpiringSoon, Canceled and Suspended are independent LicenseManagement status queries; the backend permits overlap and sums their counts for the displayed total. Do not present that sum as a deduplicated license population.
Preserve each observed status label and count from statusDistribution. Null/missing distribution means unavailable; it is not an empty category with zero.

For the key-metric overview, read totalCount and the five observed statusDistribution fields together. This panel is one component; include the overview task/cards and performance panel separately when observed. Historical completed-task buckets are for a separately requested comparison, not a replacement for visible current panels.
